title: Worms! :3
description: First version of a simple mod that adds worms and composting to minecraft. Very early alpha
body:
First version of a simple mod that adds worms and composting to minecraft. Very early alpha.

# --FEATURES--
Worms, worm colonies.

# --HOW TO GET STARTED--
Get some coarse dirt to obtain the loam recipe. Loam has a chance to drop worms when broken. Use a worm on loam to make a colony. Right click with food to get items! Beware of pests though.
